description: This file implements a driver for the STM32 backup RAM (bbram) in the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading, writing, and initializing the backup RAM hardware.

methods.name: bbram_stm32_read
methods.description: Reads data from the backup RAM at a specified offset.

methods.name: bbram_stm32_write
methods.description: Writes data to the backup RAM at a specified offset.

methods.name: bbram_stm32_get_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the backup RAM.

methods.name: bbram_stm32_init
methods.description: Initializes the backup RAM device, checking if the parent device is ready.
